title: Starlight Afterparty
intro: Backstage after the comeback showcase, the priceless holographic light-stick prototypes vanished from the merch vault.
setting: The fictional idol group LUNVIA's private backstage area. Everyone at the afterparty is trapped by security lockdown until the culprit is found.
timeline: The prototypes were secured in the vault before the showcase finale.
The vault alarm triggered right as the backstage cameras experienced a brief glitch.
A valid master override code was entered into the vault terminal.
The empty display case was discovered during the post-show celebration.

evidence.name: Camera glitch
evidence.detail: The vault hallway camera feed cut out for exactly two minutes.

evidence.name: Glitter trail
evidence.detail: A smear of stage glitter leads from the merch vault toward the green room.

evidence.name: Access log
evidence.detail: The vault terminal accepted a credential linked to management.

evidence.name: Dropped phone charger
evidence.detail: A branded phone charger was found wedged beneath the vault door frame.

revelations: The theft required both inside knowledge of the vault code and a timed distraction.
The camera glitch was triggered locally from the back office terminal.
At least one alibi completely ignores the ninety-second blackout window.

endings.culpritsCaught: The holographic prototypes are recovered from a hidden locker, and the management security breach is fully exposed.
endings.culpritsEscape: The final alarm clears, and the culprits slip away into the cheering fan crowd outside.

dialoguePrompts: Ask who knew the master override code before the showcase.
Make the dancer explain why they needed a phone charger from the vault.
Compare the livestream timestamp with the camera glitch.
Ask security who ordered the break during the exact blackout window.

tasks.name: Verify the livestream
tasks.detail: Check whether the dressing-room stream proves a location or only proves a video was playing.

tasks.name: Follow the glitter
tasks.detail: Track the stage glitter from the vault and identify who wore the matching costume.

tasks.name: Recover the charger
tasks.detail: Identify whose charger was found under the vault door.

tasks.name: Protect the comeback
tasks.detail: Keep the prototype theft secret until the group finishes the final performance.

conflicts: The manager says the override code was private, but three people knew it.
The security guard scheduled a break during the only camera glitch.
The photographer's laptop metadata disagrees with the time of the green-room photos.
The superfan reached the vault but claims they never touched the door.
secretObjectives: Recover the prototypes before the label discovers the breach.
Protect a member whose contract dispute could end the group.
Make the manager take the blame for the missing merch.
Sell the prototypes after the lockdown without revealing your buyer.
twists: The prototypes were removed from the display case during rehearsal, not the afterparty.
The camera glitch was caused by a charger plugged into the wrong terminal.
The glitter trail was planted to frame the lead stylist.
